gate.title: Ghosts Are Around You
gate.desc: Point your camera around and ghosts from across the world appear without warning. Center one in the reticle to catch it and earn credits.
gate.hint: Camera and motion-sensor access are required.
permission.title: Permission needed
permission.camera.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in Settings > Safari (or the home-screen app) > Camera.
permission.camera.inuse: The camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
permission.camera.unknown: Couldn't start the camera. Make sure you're on an HTTPS connection.
permission.orientation.denied: Motion-sensor access was denied, so you can't look around. Allow Motion & Orientation access in Settings, then retry.
hunt.orientHint: Hold up your phone and slowly look around…
